about: fk-table's application mutants; each is judged by the example's laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk10-descending-encoded-ascending
mutants.rule: Encode writes the sorting's direction (law EncodeDecodeRoundTrips).

mutants.name: fk10-period-not-encoded
mutants.rule: Encode writes the period filter (law EncodeDecodeRoundTrips).

mutants.name: fk10-bad-direction-keeps-column
mutants.rule: A sorting with a direction Decode cannot read is unsorted (law InvalidParamBecomesDefault).

mutants.name: fk10-sorting-extra-parts
mutants.rule: A sorting of more than column and direction is unsorted (law InvalidParamBecomesDefault, the near miss Name:Ascending:x).

mutants.name: fk10-any-path-is-the-table
mutants.rule: Only the root is the table (law OnlyTheRootIsTheTable).

mutants.name: fk10-plus-not-a-space
mutants.rule: A + in the query is a space (case tour: search=a+b).

mutants.name: fk10-click-other-keeps-direction
mutants.rule: A click on another column starts it ascending (law ClicksCycleTheSorting).

mutants.name: fk10-descending-click-sticks
mutants.to:
if d.Column == c {
			return Descending{Column: c}
mutants.rule: A third click on a column unsorts (law ClicksCycleTheSorting).

mutants.name: fk10-search-case-sensitive
mutants.rule: The search ignores case (case tour: SAURUS).

mutants.name: fk10-diet-filter-ignored
mutants.rule: The diet filter keeps that diet only (cases tour and badscript; RowsAreTheMatches reads Matches, so it cannot see this).

mutants.name: fk10-weight-by-length
mutants.rule: Weight sorts by weight (case tour: sort Weight).

mutants.name: fk10-descending-unstable
mutants.from: slices.SortStableFunc(kept, func(x dino.Dinosaur, y dino.Dinosaur) int { Compare(d.Column, y, x) })
mutants.to: slices.Reverse(slices.SortStableFunc(kept, func(x dino.Dinosaur, y dino.Dinosaur) int { Compare(d.Column, x, y) }))
mutants.rule: Descending ties keep the listed order, as a flipped order does, not a reversed one (law RowsAreTheMatches).

mutants.name: fk10-lost-controls-kept
mutants.rule: On a path the table is not at, a control starts from the defaults (law UrlIsAFunctionOfTheControls).

mutants.name: fk10-control-moves-state
mutants.from: Emit[query.Route, Replace]{Next: r, Output: Replace{Path: query.Encode(query.Query{..q, Search: s.Text})}}
mutants.to: Emit[query.Route, Replace]{Next: query.Browse{Query: query.Query{..q, Search: s.Text}}, Output: Replace{Path: query.Encode(query.Query{..q, Search: s.Text})}}
mutants.rule: A control changes nothing itself; the address does (law UrlIsAFunctionOfTheControls).
